POL-ADMISSION.declared_policy: Admission recomputes authorization and compares the entire presented scope.

POL-ARTIFACT.declared_policy: Both signed artifact hashes, the requested artifact, and the RVR claim must align.

POL-AUTHORITY.declared_policy: Recovered judgment and producer keys must be authorized by the supplied contract.

POL-CLAIM.declared_policy: Only REVIEWED_ARTIFACT_IDENTITY with the exact scenario and artifact-byte-identity scope is admitted.

POL-CONTRACT.declared_policy: Recomputed canonical contract SHA-256 must match the requested context.

POL-COVERAGE.declared_policy: Contract-required O14 must be present even if all declared checks pass.

POL-FIELDS.declared_policy: This REJECT contract cannot promote an unconsumed payment field into authorization.

POL-O14.declared_policy: Distinct recovered keys are required only when this scenario contract requires role separation.

POL-POLICY.declared_policy: Signed policyHash must bind that exact contract, not another policy.

POL-PREIMAGE.declared_policy: Without canonical contract bytes, contract binding is UNVERIFIABLE.

POL-SCOPE.declared_policy: Signed review scope and action must match the supplied contract.

POL-SIGNATURE.declared_policy: Both laboratory EIP-712 signatures must verify; missing is UNVERIFIABLE.

POL-SUBJECT.declared_policy: Signed subjects must match the exact requested subject.

P1.declared_policy: Only LAB_REGISTRY_TRANSITION is admitted; no task truth or payment authorization.

P2.declared_policy: The requested policy version must equal this scenario policy.

P3.declared_policy: Unknown claim fields are rejected, not silently consumed.

P4.declared_policy: Claim agent_id must match the actual operation subject.

P5.declared_policy: Claim operation must match the executed operation.

P6.declared_policy: Claim chain ID and registry role must match the executed domain.

P7.declared_policy: A required unavailable transaction receipt makes the claim UNVERIFIABLE.

P8.declared_policy: An actually reverted transaction cannot support a successful transition claim.

REVIEW-DEFINITIONS.declared_policy: Catalog procedure and dependency definitions must equal the independently supplied contract requirements.

REVIEW-SCENARIO.declared_policy: Requested scenario must equal the exact scenario contract scenario.
